about.description: The Sunliner Diner is a classic 1950s themed American diner with three locations featuring retro newspaper menus, collector cars, hand-spun milkshakes, and classic diner cuisine with breakfast served all day. Step back in time and enjoy togetherness, nostalgia, and comfort food in a chrome-trimmed setting.

menu.name: Shrimp Benedict
menu.description: Two poached eggs, Creole seasoned Gulf shrimp, sliced red tomato covered with Creole hollandaise sauce on top of a Sunliner biscuit. Served with hash browns or grits.

menu.name: Classic Benedict
menu.description: Two poached eggs with Creole hollandaise sauce, smoked ham on top of an English muffin. Served with hash browns or grits.

menu.name: Chicken & Waffle Benedict
menu.description: Belgian waffle, hand-battered fried boneless chicken breast, two poached eggs covered with Creole hollandaise sauce. Topped with chopped bell peppers, drizzled with syrup. Served with hash browns or grits.

menu.name: Avocado Benedict
menu.description: Two poached eggs, fresh avocado, and sliced red tomato covered with Creole hollandaise sauce on top of a Sunliner biscuit. Topped with chopped bell peppers and served with hash browns or grits.

menu.name: Banana Nut French Toast
menu.description: Texas toast soaked in a sweet custard topped with fresh bananas, candied pecans, two layers of candied bacon, and drizzled with caramel sauce.

menu.name: Chocolate Chip Pancakes
menu.description: Three light and fluffy buttermilk pancakes filled with chocolate chip morsels.

menu.name: Buttermilk Pancakes
menu.description: Three light and fluffy buttermilk pancakes.

menu.name: Sunliner French Toast
menu.description: Texas toast soaked in homemade sweet custard, topped with caramel sauce and powdered sugar.

menu.name: Seasonal Specialty Pancakes
menu.description: Three light and fluffy buttermilk pancakes with your choice of fresh bananas, blueberries, or strawberries on top.
